name: gemini-spell
title: Pi Spell Checker
description: Fix spelling and rewrite selected text with the local Pi CLI.
author: tulio_paim

preferences.name: piBin
preferences.title: Pi Binary Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the pi executable. Leave blank to resolve from common PATH locations.

preferences.name: piThinking
preferences.title: Pi Thinking
preferences.description: Thinking level to pass to pi --thinking

preferences.name: requestTimeoutMs
preferences.title: Request Timeout (ms)
preferences.description: Cancel Pi runs slower than this timeout

preferences.name: debugLogs
preferences.title: Debug Logs
preferences.description: Log Pi execution details to Raycast console without sensitive environment values
preferences.label: Enable debug logs in Raycast console

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
